subject.title: macOS app: dashboard fails silently with unresolved ${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN} placeholder when env var not in app's environment, with no in-app recovery path

question: Which linked PR should be treated as the canonical fix for the macOS dashboard auth placeholder lockout?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but multiple open PRs overlap the same root cause and some only address gateway-side or symptom-level behavior; choosing the landing candidate is a maintainer coordination choice.

options.title: Review and land the macOS fallback PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101375 as the leading candidate once it has current-head real macOS app proof and required maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Choose another linked PR as canonical
options.body: Use another open linked PR if it provides stronger real app proof, cleaner upgrade behavior, or a better owner-boundary fix.

options.title: Ask for a replacement if candidates stall
options.body: Keep this issue open and create a narrow replacement only if the existing linked PRs cannot be brought to a landable state.

recommendation.title: Review and land the macOS fallback PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101375 as the leading candidate once it has current-head real macOS app proof and required maintainer acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the native macOS dashboard and gateway endpoint surface where the canonical fix will land.
